'''Harilin's Leap''' is an inn in [[Jarra (village)|Jarra]], [[Ghealdan]]. {{ref/book|3|8}}


==Appearance==
It is a square stone building.

===Sign===
The sign is "a man standing on one foot with his arms thrown in the air."

==Employees==

*Master [[Harod]] - innkeeper
*[[Simion]]
*[[Nico]] - stableboy
*[[Patrim]] - stableboy
